edit_summary.reason: The policy farms repeatable bonuses (controlled_descent_bonus, touchdown_stability_bonus) while staying near the ground off-pad. Previous attempts to tighten conditions or add improvement bonuses failed. This revision restructures the reward: (1) Makes controlled_descent_bonus one-shot event-gated (fires once when first entering near-pad region with main engine use). (2) Makes touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot event-gated (fires once when both legs contact near pad with low velocities). (3) Adds a strong distance improvement bonus (+0.5 per unit distance decrease) to provide a clear gradient toward the pad. (4) Increases distance penalty to -0.1 to provide a stronger gradient. (5) Removes repeatable positive bonuses to prevent farming. The one-shot bonuses provide a clear milestone signal, and the distance improvement bonus provides continuous guidance. Unlike the failed iter_009->010 revision, this revision uses a larger one-shot controlled_descent_bonus (+10 instead of +5) and a smaller distance improvement bonus cap (+0.5 instead of +1.0) to ensure the policy can reach the triggering conditions without the improvement bonus dominating.
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
changed_design: Make controlled_descent_bonus one-shot event-gated: +10.0 bonus fires once when the lander first enters the near-pad region (distance<0.3) with main engine use (m_power>0) and upright (|angle|<0.2). Track with self._controlled_descent_given flag.

Make touchdown_stability_bonus one-shot event-gated: +20.0 bonus fires once when both legs contact near the pad (distance<0.3) with low velocities (|vy|<0.5, |vx|<0.5) and small angle (|angle|<0.2). Track with self._touchdown_stability_given flag.

Add distance_improvement_bonus: +0.5 * (prev_distance - current_distance) when distance decreases, capped at +0.5 per step. This provides a strong, continuous incentive to move closer to the pad. Use self._prev_distance to track previous distance, reset at episode start via hasattr check.
Increase progress_shaping distance penalty scale from -0.05 to -0.1 to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad.
Remove the repeatable controlled_descent_bonus (was +0.5 per step) and repeatable touchdown_stability_bonus (was +10 per step) to prevent farming.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not make bonuses repeatable without phase conditioning: now one-shot event-gated.
Do not tighten distance conditions without providing a strong gradient: added distance_improvement_bonus.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: bonuses are now one-shot and conditioned on progress.
Do not only reduce distance shaping: we increase it and add improvement bonus.
Do not make one-shot bonuses too small to motivate approach (failed pattern from iter_009->010 used +5 for controlled_descent): this revision uses +10.
Do not cap improvement bonus too high (failed pattern from iter_009->010 used +1.0 cap): this revision uses +0.5 cap to prevent the improvement bonus from dominating.
edit_summary.action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The distance improvement bonus will encourage the policy to use orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to steer toward the pad, potentially increasing their usage from ~15% to ~20%. The increased distance penalty will encourage more main engine use (action 2) to descend faster toward the pad.
edit_summary.phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_improvement_bonus (+0.5 per unit distance decrease, capped at +0.5 per step) provides a strong gradient to move toward the pad. Increased distance penalty (-0.1 * distance) also encourages approach. Phase 2 (descent): one-shot controlled_descent_bonus (+10) fires when first entering near-pad region with main engine use, providing a milestone signal. Phase 3 (touchdown): one-shot touchdown_stability_bonus (+20) fires when both legs contact near the pad with low velocities, providing a milestone signal. Success bonus (+100) provides final sparse signal.
edit_summary.payment_mode_plan: distance_improvement_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), so it naturally diminishes as the lander approaches the pad and cannot be farmed indefinitely. controlled_descent_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
